canonical_project: West Bengal State Data Centre (Webel Bhaban, Salt Lake Sector-V)
owner: Government of West Bengal / Webel Technology Limited
notes: The West Bengal State Data Centre operates at Webel Bhaban, Salt Lake Sector-V, Bidhannagar (North 24 Parganas district): Tier-III+, 12,000+ sq ft, ~1.5 PB storage, with the older Tier-II facility (operational since 2009) at the Manibhandar building, Webel Complex, Sector-V. Reassigned from Kolkata to North 24 Parganas on physical location (Bidhannagar municipal area); first-round discovery had placed it under Kolkata.
